Plot Summary Public Safety Saga Plot Summary Denji is a lonely boy who one day meets a Devil, Pochita. The two end up becoming friends, however Denji is soon killed and to save him, Pochita becomes his new heart, making him a human-devil hybrid and allowing him to become the Chainsaw Man. Soon after that, Denji meets Makima and decides to follow her and join the Public Safety and become a Devil Hunter. At his new job, he makes new friends, like Aki Hayakawa and Power, and together they go on different missions to exterminate devils. Eventually, Aki and Power are killed and Makima is exposed to be the Control Devil, who wants to control the Chainsaw Devil. Denji is then forced to fight and defeat Makima and her new squad of hybrids. Despite all of her bonding, she knows that Yoru will never willingly return her body to her. Asa also believes that even if the Death Devil wipes out humanity, Denji could still survive. Still in disbelief, Denji asks her what would happen to her, and she admits that, due to the overwhelming guilt she feels over her actions, she simply doesn’t care anymore. However, since she wishes to go out doing something good, she urges Denji to eat her as she takes advantage of Yoru. In the real world, Yoru revives once more as Famine uses some of her own blood to accelerate Pochita’s recovery. She yells at Famine for being too weak and for sullying her holy war, but the Famine Devil retorts that Yoru is the true weakling as she revs Pochita’s ripcord herself. Before Yoru can retaliate, Asa momentarily regains control and turns her finger on herself, blowing off the top half of her head. Miri then intervenes, bisecting the War Devil’s body before instructing Death to deploy Guilly. In response, the Death Devil summons the Guillotine Devil and orders it to mince Yoru’s body. The Death Devil’s allies subsequently tell Chainsaw Man to consume her, but he decapitates them instead, making it clear that, in one way or another, he intends to save Asa. served_qa: Summary Chapter 146 Summary Meanwhile, while Barem is being escorted by Denji, Fumiko, Nayuta, and multiple Public Safety agents, he begins to explain the church's previous actions. He explains that, while the Chainsaw Man Church lied about the devil's identity, the rest of their story was truthful. He explains that Fami's connections in the Devil world allowed them to contract the members with a particularly powerful Devil - one that can allow users to transform into any form that they desire - the Fire Devil. As he says this, a nearby building, presumably a Chainsaw Man Church building, catches on fire and begins billowing smoke out of a window. As onlookers watch and police officers guard the building, several members in the crowd begin sprouting chainsaws out of their heads and arms and begin attacking the police. It's revealed that this is a worldwide phenomenon with many people, presumably church members, turning into humanoid Chainsaw Devils. Members inside the church building, raided by Katana Man and the Nail Fiend, begin transforming as well, which prompts Katana Man to attack and shout out Chainsaw Man's name in rage.
